subject.title: [Feature] Allow configuring Gemini safety settings in OpenClaw

question: Should OpenClaw expose a first-class Gemini safety-settings config knob, and if so what exact schema, categories, thresholds, and precedence should it support?
rationale: This would add a new safety-affecting provider config surface and change Google request behavior, so automation should not choose the public contract or safety posture without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve a narrow Google setting
options.body: Add a strict Google-scoped `models.providers.*.safetySettings` or equivalent contract with documented categories, thresholds, request precedence, and focused config/runtime tests.

options.title: Keep provider defaults only
options.body: Decline the config surface for now and keep Gemini safety behavior on Google's defaults to avoid a new safety-affecting knob.

options.title: Design a broader provider-settings seam
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define a reusable provider-specific settings pattern for Google and similar provider-owned request options.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow Google setting
recommendation.body: Add a strict Google-scoped `models.providers.*.safetySettings` or equivalent contract with documented categories, thresholds, request precedence, and focused config/runtime tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is most directly connected to recent Google provider/config history and prior maintainer-side routing on this issue.
